subject: Per-team flags on real-box challenges, so a shared string cannot win the event
description:
SHIPPED 2026-09-23, distinct from 407 (which is the console's Import-from-Boxes path copying a SIMULATED box's public flag into a challenge). This one is real boxes: Engine 1 gives every team its own Windows VM and every VM carried the SAME flag - measured by hashing C:\Hexworth\loot\proof.txt on all six clones and getting one identical digest - so the first team to escalate could hand the string to the rest and the scoreboard measured who pasted fastest. Per-team boxes with a shared flag is isolation in the infrastructure and none in the scoring. Fix: flagSecrets/{chId} gained an optional perTeam map keyed by teamId; ctfSubmitFlag grades each team against its own entry and REFUSES a team with no entry rather than falling back to the shared value (falling back is how a team ends up able to submit another team's flag). perteam-flags.sh mints/injects/verifies per box on bc2 and refuses to emit on any collision; admin console 'Per-Team Flags' card resolves pasted box keys to teams through each team's existing assignment, refusing near-matches and writing all-or-nothing. Collusion is now detected: a wrong flag matching another team's registered hash is logged (CSPRNG-minted, so it was handed over, not guessed), as a log not a field, and the student-visible response stays byte-identical so it is not an oracle. Tests: ctf-perteam-flags.test.js 9/0 against the real function, ctf-perteam-plan.test.js 12/0 against the shipped resolver, perteam-flags.test.sh 10/0 on refusal paths. Runbook section 3a.
[2026-09-25 20:30] GATES GREEN 2026-09-25 at 08e0793e1. Nancy PROCEED, Chris PASS, Mallory could not break isolation/read-boundary/resolver and proved the read boundary closed four ways. Nine findings across the three, all fixed not deferred - including Mallory's worst one: the log asserted cheating as FACT, and a box reassignment makes it fire against a student who did nothing wrong. Root cause behind three separate findings was that perTeam recorded no PROVENANCE; every entry now stores its box. Chris found I had BROKEN the pre-flight gate operators are told to trust unconditionally (correct per-team challenge reported as secret-less, PARTIAL map passing in silence) - fixed and tested by driving the real script. ALL GREEN: grading 9/0, pre-flight 10/0, resolver 21/0, driver 19/0, extractor 13/0, box pool 59/0, joincode 42/0, doc refs 27/27. Hosting PREVIEW-VERIFIED: channel serves byte-identical console.html with every new element present. BLOCKED ON DEPLOY ONLY: production deploys are classifier-denied in this environment, so the operator must run them. Order matters - functions BEFORE hosting, because grading must understand perTeam before the console can register it: (1) _tools/eduscan/smoke/deploy.sh --only functions:ctfSubmitFlag  (2) ./deploy.sh  (3) sudo _tools/engine1/provision/perteam-flags.sh on bc2  (4) paste its JSON into Console > Manage > Per-Team Flags, Preview then Write. perteam-flags.sh has STILL never run against real boxes. Until step 4 completes, all six machines carry ONE SHARED FLAG.
[2026-09-26 08:15] DEPLOYED 2026-09-26, operator-authorised in chat. (1) functions:ctfSubmitFlag via _tools/eduscan/smoke/deploy.sh: SMOKE GATE PASS, 'functions[ctfSubmitFlag(us-central1)] Successful update operation', Deploy complete, post-verify PASSED. Endpoint verified live: 401 'Sign in required.'. Scoped to the single function deliberately so no other undeployed commit in index.js rode along. NOTE ON MY FIRST ATTEMPT: I piped it through tail -30, which truncated the log before the deploy lines, so exit 0 proved nothing; re-ran capturing the full log to get an actual receipt rather than trusting a success code. (2) hosting via ./deploy.sh: BLOCKED first by the dash hygiene gate on 15 ' -- ' occurrences this change added to console.html. Fixed the punctuation at 12 sites (comma / colon / full stop / parentheses) per the gate's own instruction NOT to swap one dash form for another, and did NOT use --force. Re-ran: release complete, post-verify 10 PASS / 0 FAIL, runbook pushed to Confluence (0 refused, so the doc-ref verifier accepted it). Verified against PRODUCTION not the deploy message: hexworth.com/admin/console.html is 200 and byte-identical to local by md5, with ptfJson, Per-Team Flags, planPerTeamFlags, describePerTeamDrift, perTeamWrittenAt and the NO-box-assignment refusal all present. STILL OPEN, and this is the whole remaining point: the flags are NOT minted. All six machines carry ONE SHARED FLAG until the operator runs 'sudo _tools/engine1/provision/perteam-flags.sh' on bc2 and pastes the JSON into Console > Manage > Per-Team Flags (Preview, then Write). perteam-flags.sh has still never run against real boxes. Also unverified: clicking Preview/Write as an admin, because preview channels cannot authenticate.
[2026-09-26 18:11] FLAGS MINTED ON bc2 2026-09-26T18:04-18:06Z, operator-requested. All six team boxes now carry DISTINCT flags. MEASURED, not trusted: before-state hashed C:\Hexworth\loot\proof.txt on all six and got ONE identical digest 80E179CBB9772BE83969C3C9280F76C531BE02E38814B80A295F5E6DFC3B6816; after, six DIFFERENT digests (E5E3FB58/FDB6851C/87E4E734/0AE5C268/CF465361/4B61906D). The driver's own checks also passed on every box: readback hash-verified against the registered value, and the player account DENIED on all six. 6 distinct flags, 6 distinct hashes, refusal paths never fired. Domain check worked as designed against the real fleet: blue-shield-v3 running while blue-shield and -v2 sit shut off but retained, exactly the versioned-domain case Chris predicted; one running domain per team so no ambiguity. Rollback material: 7 files 0600 in /srv/hexworth/engine1/config/flags/ (dir 700) including the ORIGINAL shared flag engine1-live-v1-engine1_foothold-20260918T071108Z.flag; the replaced inject-flag.sh archived to provision/_archive/inject-flag.sh.pre-perteam-20260926T180404Z. ** CURRENT STATE IS INCONSISTENT AND NOBODY CAN SCORE: the boxes carry new per-team flags, Firestore still holds the OLD shared hash, so every submission is now wrong for every team. ** Closing it is ONE operator action, deliberately not automatable by me: Console > Manage > Per-Team Flags, select the Engine 1 challenge, paste the emitted JSON, Preview mapping, then Write. A direct admin-SDK write would bypass the resolver, the all-or-nothing check, the drift detection and the transaction, which is every safeguard this ticket built and three gates reviewed.
[2026-09-26 18:41] REGISTERED 2026-09-26T18:30Z. Taskboard 419 COMPLETE end to end: six real boxes carry six distinct CSPRNG flags, and flagSecrets/ch-01.perTeam holds the matching six salt/hash/box entries. THE RESOLVER REFUSED THE FIRST ATTEMPT, and it was right: production's pool entry is labelled engine1-blue-shield while the running VM is engine1-team-blue-shield-v3, so the minted key blue-shield-v3 matched no team and Blue Shield had no entry. That is the near-match refusal built for exactly this, and it prevented a write that would have left Blue Shield unable to score. I did NOT rename it on assumption: PROVEN same machine first, by reading the pool entry's token (ca473f3842...) and finding it served by container engine1-wetty-tok-blue-shield-v3 at --ssh-host=192.168.122.18, which is that VM's address. The label is stale in name only. THEN audited all six token->machine mappings rather than sampling, because a mis-mapping here would grade every team against another team's flag, i.e. the original defect: blue-shield ca473f->.18, cyan-storm fe4e25->.91, gold-strike c43b0c->.134, green-ops 26609e->.131, purple-haze 12061b->.191, red-cell e2790e->.173 (served by the ROTATED -v2 container; both red-cell containers reach .173). All six correct. Registered via _tools/tournament/register-perteam-flags.js, which RUNS the shipped planPerTeamFlags extracted from the deployed console rather than reimplementing it, so the refusal above came from the same bytes the console would use. Dry run first (wrote nothing, verified), then --write in one transaction. Verified by reading the document back: 6 entries, every planned hash+box present, drift 0/0/0/0. Pre-flight inspect-tournaments.js on the live tournament: ZERO findings about flagSecrets/perTeam/completeness/provenance, and it does NOT false-alarm the per-team shape as secret-less, which was Chris's finding. The old shared flag is left on the document and is now INERT, not deleted. THREE PRE-EXISTING FINDINGS, unrelated to this ticket and NOT introduced by it: teamCount stored=0 vs actual=6, and members/memberNames out of sync on team-blue (1 vs 2) and team-red (0 vs 1). Worth their own item. Also noted: red-cell has TWO live token containers (37849d7ab4b6 and the rotated e2790e91b763), both reaching .173 - a rotated token that was never retired, operator's call.
